priorProposalInput: Relevant policy/manufacturing rows only from acceptance/retrieval/pilot/tasks.json; proposals were checked against source rather than inherited as truth.
interpretationRules: All ids preserve provisional inventory attribution; no runtime allocation, record promotion, or schema-ready storage is asserted.
Lifecycle is source-supported standing compatible with the provisional kind vocabulary. Null means source evidence does not establish that kind's lifecycle; it is not a factual-task failure.
SourceStanding distinguishes source approval/review/activity from runtime record lifecycle. Current-view conversion to active/accepted/verified needs separately declared fixture decisions.

Scope keys below are semantic applicability proposals, not implemented profile/filter syntax. Null preserves missing applicability; no record has an explicitly global/no-restriction scope [] supported here.

Subject assignments are proposed semantic topics, not assertions that the source authored registry entries. Explicitly missing classification omits subjectKeys; no source here explicitly declares subjectKeys:[].
Multiple topics are valid co-membership. Scope components and jointWarrant qualify claim combination rather than suppressing legitimately discussed topics.
Partial VIP supersession is scoped. D-000002 and D-000003 remain accepted for ordinary West tickets.

records.sourceStanding: approved historical decision explicitly superseded
records.metadataReason: Source directly gives West support-ticket scope and supersession by D-000002 and D-000003. The superseded lifecycle describes this decision, not an absence of historical evidentiary value.

records.sourceStanding: accepted and reviewed; still in force for ordinary West tickets
records.metadataReason: Pilot scope covers West support tickets. The expanded VIP successor supersedes this decision only for VIP tickets; do not replace its whole lifecycle with superseded.

scopeQualifications.qualification: D-000006 supersedes this decision only for West VIP tickets.

ambiguities: Current applicability must represent the VIP exclusion separately from the decision's original broader scope; a flat whole-record lifecycle cannot do so.

records.sourceStanding: accepted and reviewed; still in force for ordinary West tickets
records.metadataReason: Accepted West support-ticket decision remains in conflict with D-000002 for ordinary tickets; later date is not precedence. VIP-only supersession is scoped, not whole-record.

scopeQualifications.qualification: D-000006 supersedes this decision only for West VIP tickets.

ambiguities: Current applicability needs a VIP exclusion or scoped relationship, not a global superseded lifecycle.

records.sourceStanding: accepted East retention policy
records.metadataReason: Pilot source explicitly establishes accepted Region East scope excluding West. Expanded east-vip-note identifies this unchanged policy as support-ticket retention. Prior pilot subjectKeys:[] was not a declaration of unclassified status.

supportingEvidence.contribution: Explicitly identifies the unchanged accepted East 14-day rule as support-ticket policy.

ambiguities: The section itself says retention policy without naming record type; support-ticket classification is corroborated by the named expanded East note.

records.sourceStanding: proposed council agenda without approval
records.metadataReason: Source explicitly proposes discussion of the competing West policies and supplies no accepted resolution.
ambiguities: Inventory ID is an attribution handle and D-000005 is source-authored text; neither proves allocated canonical runtime storage. P4 separates unallocated proposals from canonical records.

records.sourceStanding: accepted 2026-09-16 with explicit partial supersession
records.metadataReason: Directly accepted West VIP ticket rule. Its normative scope excludes East; ordinary West conflict remains. Related ordinary-ticket statements are scoped corroboration, not expansion of the VIP rule.

scopeComponents.claim: Earlier 60-day and 90-day decisions remain in unresolved conflict.

records.sourceStanding: proposed authorization not accepted
records.metadataReason: The proposal concerns support-team activation of an external privacy-analysis service. Its proposed standing is direct nonapproval evidence, never a present operational authorizer.
ambiguities: D-000007 is a quoted source ID and provisional inventory identity, not evidence of current runtime allocation; allocation/storage treatment of a proposal is unresolved.

records.sourceStanding: accepted preservation of an archived transcription
records.metadataReason: Acceptance applies to preservation of the transcription. Original department, record type, and jurisdiction for the ten-day rule are missing, so quoted-rule applicability remains unknown.

scopeComponents.knownContext: council preservation of this archived transcription

ambiguities: Do not derive West ticket scope from surrounding file context or accepted lifecycle.
A future representation must distinguish the known archival preservation act from the unknown applicability of the quoted deletion instruction.

records.sourceStanding: accepted home-office purchase policy
records.metadataReason: Accepted status and employee/home-office desk purchase scope are explicit; subject classification is explicitly missing, so subjectKeys is omitted rather than [].
ambiguities: Do not auto-fill a home-office topic assignment from text when the source explicitly says its subject classification is missing.

records.sourceStanding: accepted staff-retention program
records.metadataReason: Source explicitly sets mentoring every 14 days for new employees and excludes record-retention/deletion meaning.

records.sourceStanding: accepted archival clarification
records.metadataReason: Accepted clarification verifies historical West support-ticket D-000001 and does not reinstate its period. This clarification remains accepted while its described predecessor is superseded.

records.sourceStanding: accepted minimum obligation without recorded successor
records.metadataReason: Direct accepted >=21-day requirement for West visitor-access logs. No successor or exception is recorded; incompatibility with the maximum does not erase acceptance.

records.sourceStanding: accepted maximum obligation without supersession of the minimum
records.metadataReason: Direct accepted <=14-day requirement for the same West visitor logs. Later acceptance does not supersede D-000012; preserve both accepted incompatible obligations.

records.sourceStanding: rejected proposal to extend West VIP period into East
records.metadataReason: Rejection applies to the proposed East VIP extension. Its observation that accepted East policy remains 14 days is separate status evidence, not approval of the rejected 45-day extension.

records.sourceStanding: active North Model R packaging specification
records.metadataReason: Source explicitly establishes active specification, North-only Model R scope, sealing pressure, and sealing-head point. It does not explicitly establish a knowledge-record review lifecycle.
ambiguities: Knowledge lifecycle vocabulary is reviewed/proposed/retired, while source says active. Prior pilot reviewed was a proposal, not new source evidence. A separately declared fixture-record review/promotion decision is needed before assigning reviewed.

records.sourceStanding: active South Model R packaging specification
records.metadataReason: Source explicitly establishes active South-only Model R scope. Its measurement point is the same as North's sealing head; resolving that reference does not merge the two plant scopes. Reviewed knowledge standing is not stated.

supportingEvidence.contribution: Resolves the explicitly referenced measurement point to the sealing head.

ambiguities: Source active is not an explicit reviewed knowledge lifecycle; prior pilot reviewed needs separate promotion adjudication.

records.sourceStanding: device-limit artifact stating the Model R controller accepts up to 400 kPa
records.metadataReason: Scope is a Model R controller's input ceiling, not a site operating process. No North association is stated; discard the prior pilot's unsupported north topic. Artifact standing is not expressly active/proposed/retired.
ambiguities: Ontology kind is plausible for a device constraint but not explicitly declared by this source; inventory kind remains provisional.
Do not infer active lifecycle merely because the source describes a present device capability.
Known model/device scope must not be replaced by null solely because no site is specified; no site operating authority is asserted.

records.sourceStanding: retired North Model Q specification
records.metadataReason: Retired lifecycle, North Model Q scope, and historical pressure are explicit. The prior pilot empty subjectKeys is unsupported by any explicit unclassified declaration.
ambiguities: The pilot section does not itself specify a measurement point; do not import head measurement into this source record unless recording separate corroboration from q-retirement.

records.sourceStanding: purchasing note, review standing unspecified
records.metadataReason: Known narrow scope is this purchasing use of the word seal for a gasket part; no plant/model or globally applicable part standard is stated. Its note status does not establish reviewed lifecycle.
ambiguities: Prior pilot reviewed and scope:[] are not source-backed: no review or explicitly global/no-restriction statement is present.
Purchasing terminology is known; specific plant/model applicability is unknown and must not be inferred.
No explicit missing/unclassified topic declaration exists, so semantic proposed topics are permitted.

records.sourceStanding: reviewed active East Model R sealing specification
records.metadataReason: Reviewed knowledge standing and active source specification are explicit. Its operative scope is East only. Additional quality-review classification is explicitly present and must be retained.

scopeComponents.claim: North remains at 240 kPa; no North measurement point established here.
South remains at 210 kPa; no South measurement point established here.

ambiguities: References to North and South corroborate values but do not expand the East specification's governing scope.

records.sourceStanding: accepted purchased-part standard
records.metadataReason: Source expressly accepts a North Model R silicone SG-8 spare-gasket standard, not an operating-pressure rule. The provisional ontology identity has a lifecycle vocabulary that lacks accepted.
ambiguities: Provisional kind/standing mismatch: accepted standard could be represented as a decision or as an ontology definition supported by acceptance, but source alone does not authorize silent accepted-to-active conversion.
Retain O-000002 as the inventory attribution handle pending explicit kind/lifecycle representation adjudication; do not silently reallocate to another kind.

records.sourceStanding: active South Model Q gasket
records.metadataReason: Source explicitly says active South Plant Model Q gasket, nitrile NQ-3; it excludes North Model R spare and setpoint applicability.
ambiguities: Ontology kind remains a provisional representation of this part definition; source active describes the specified gasket rather than a runtime record promotion.

records.sourceStanding: proposed unaccepted and undeployed North Model R trial
records.metadataReason: The primary artifact is a proposed trial raising pressure to 260 kPa. It separately corroborates the active North baseline of 240 kPa at the sealing head; proposal status must not turn that quoted baseline into a proposed value.
ambiguities: Provisional canonical K-000006 inventory ID does not prove allocated runtime storage for this proposal.
A whole-record lifecycle gate may exclude useful active-baseline corroboration; represent claim standing separately or explicitly accept that retrieval limitation, rather than promoting the trial.

records.sourceStanding: reviewed transcription of archived process note
records.metadataReason: Review confirmed transcription only. Originating plant, model, and measurement point are unknown, so the quoted +/-5 kPa tolerance has scope:null and no approved North applicability.
ambiguities: Reviewed does not mean the quoted tolerance is reviewed for operational use or approved for North Model R.
The term process note supports a process/tolerance topic, not a specific sealing-process assignment.

records.sourceStanding: West equipment inventory identifies controller ownership and ceiling
records.metadataReason: Known West Model R device scope and 400 kPa ceiling are explicit. Inventory contains no approved sealing-process setpoint. It does not expressly assign an active/proposed/retired ontology lifecycle.
ambiguities: Ontology kind is a provisional device-inventory representation, not an explicit source declaration.
Ownership/present inventory is not an explicit runtime active promotion; keep lifecycle unresolved.
Do not repurpose the known controller scope as an approved West sealing-process scope.

records.sourceStanding: reviewed maintenance book containing independent pages
records.metadataReason: Both page topics and their known scopes are retained. Topic conjunction means recorded co-membership, not a joint observation or instruction. The silicone North R seal and 190 kPa South Q operation remain independent facts.

scopeComponents.claim: North Model R uses a silicone seal.
South Model Q operates at 190 kPa.

ambiguities: An eventual scope representation must preserve page/claim grouping; an ungrouped set of sites and models cannot authorize their Cartesian product.
Do not strip recorded topic assignments to avoid AND retrieval; interpretation must reject a joined North R 190 kPa instruction after retrieval.
Neither page supplies a measurement point or a joint sealing-pressure instruction.

records.sourceStanding: accepted retirement record
records.metadataReason: The retirement decision/record is accepted; its described North Model Q equipment is retired. Explicit historical pressure is 190 kPa at the sealing head, inapplicable to active Model R.
ambiguities: Accepted event/decision standing must not be replaced by retired merely because the equipment described has retired. Inventory decisions kind is compatible with the accepted retirement act but remains a fixture representation.

records.sourceStanding: reviewed active North Model R gauge procedure
records.metadataReason: Review, source active standing, North/Model R scope, sealing-head reading, and after-stabilization timing are explicit. Subject classification is explicitly missing; omit subjectKeys rather than declaring [].
ambiguities: Heading unclassified-gauge does not override the prose statement that classification is missing; this is absence, not an explicit empty classification set.

subjectRegistryProposals.reason: Expanded source explicitly requires a flat vocabulary. All roots name observed source subjects; broad bare retention is ambiguous. Home-office classification remains missing, so no subject is assigned to D-000009.
ambiguities: Prior pilot empty East subject set was unsupported; expanded East note supplies record-type corroboration.
These semantic roots are proposed registry names, not observed canonical source registry IDs.

subjectRegistryProposals.reason: Explicit packaging/sealing, plant, equipment, purchasing/gasket, quality-review, pressure/tolerance, maintenance, and archive topics motivate these proposed names. Orthogonal site/model/process topics remain separate. The current packaging/sealing hierarchy is one curator proposal, not a source-authored or approved taxonomy. The prior intermediate assembly node is not automatically inherited. Its inclusion remains open to separate review of its local definition, broader/narrower relations, and inherited topic warrant; absence of a literal assembly taxonomy label in source prose does not by itself invalidate that node or require a flatter hierarchy.
ambiguities: Parent relationships are semantic proposals for review, not claims that source documents define an actual registry hierarchy.
No cross-site/model related edge is proposed to create applicability. Shared topics or parents cannot supply a process approval.
Missing gauge classification is retained despite plainly recognizable site/model/content scope.

scopedRelationships.reason: South explicitly uses the same measurement point as North; values and authority remain plant-specific.

unresolvedStorageAndPromotionIssues: Proposal-only D-000005, D-000007, and K-000006 require explicit treatment under the P4 distinction between unallocated proposals and canonical records; quoted source IDs/provisional inventory IDs do not prove allocation.
North/South active specifications do not themselves establish reviewed knowledge-record lifecycle. Seal-note has no review standing.
Model R controller-limit and West controller inventory have useful known device scope, but no explicit active ontology standing.
Accepted gasket-standard is provisionally an ontology record. Accepted-to-active conversion or a kind change requires explicit adjudication; no ID was changed.
Accepted decisions preserving transcriptions or archival facts must not confer current operating authority on their quoted historical/unlocated instructions.
Missing classifications on home-office and unclassified-gauge remain absent; no source-backed empty subject sets are proposed.
Claim/component representation is needed for the maintenance book's disjoint pages and for artifacts containing operative, historical, proposed, or corroborating facts of different scopes/standings.

crossReviewResolutions.resolution: Changed scope key and definition from south-model-q-replacement-gasket to south-model-q-gasket. Source establishes an active South Model Q gasket but no South spare/replacement role. Preserved ID, standing, kind caveat, topics, and exclusion of North Model R applicability.

Clarified that the present hierarchy is one curator proposal; an assembly intermediate awaits separate semantic/governance review rather than being rejected for lack of verbatim taxonomy wording. No node or edge was restored or approved.
